          ║  v             stop                 click                select a track      ║          
          ║  z             previous track       double click         play it             ║          
          ║  b             next track           right click          track actions       ║

          ║  right         seek forward 5s      right click          play or pause       ║

          ║  shift+right   seek forward 30s     click [ON ]          enable or bypass    ║

          ║  pgdn          page down            click title / artist open music database ║          
          ║  home / gg     first track          overlays                                 ║
